model_review.assessment: Existing lookup_unit_vitals reads target health/health_max. Nonretail directenv state transition test is grounded by prose, planned separately; no source signature/default inference or native credit.

Era HasKey returns false. Real bag_items membership is gated Forever only, not Era. Keyring addition supplies no slot mapping, capacity, identity query arguments/returns or HasKey contract. Do not copy foreign model/aliases/defaults or promote name availability.

Current send_chat_message appends outbound state/chat text without a hardware-event check. Source gives no failure result/security shape or authorized event lifetime. Existing behavior is not parity; no invented guard model.

Legacy send_addon_message logs arbitrary channel string and enqueues CHAT_MSG_ADDON; accepts CHANNEL. C_ChatInfo path is separate. Source supplies no result/failure shape, routing or delivery semantics; leave transition UNPROVEN rather than fabricate historical signature or rejection.
